payload.name: Preserve explicit timing in extracted event memories
payload.description: When extracting an event memory from a message that includes an explicit time phrase like 'a year ago', 'last week', or 'in 2020', include that timing in the memory content.
content: During extraction, if a source message states a time for an event (e.g., 'a year ago', 'last week', 'in 2020'), record that temporal detail in the memory content rather than omitting it while keeping entities and locations.

Resolve relative time expressions against the session/message timestamp when needed, but keep the explicit temporal anchor or its resolved value in the memory so the event's timing remains answerable.
Apply this to all event memories such as purchases, acquisitions, or occurrences whenever the timing is explicitly mentioned.

solves: When constructing an event memory, explicit temporal expressions such as 'a year ago', 'last week', or 'in 2020' are sometimes dropped while entities and locations are kept, making time-based questions unanswerable. This skill ensures such timing details are preserved or resolved in extracted event memories whenever the source states them.
